book: A volume of two works by Johannes Heidfeldius, both printed at Herborn in 1608: the Hierarchia, a set of panegyric orations on the four estates (economic, political, ecclesiastical, scholastic) followed by miscellaneous excerpts, errata and a table; and the Idea, sive forma et exemplar optimi principis, with its own dedication, preface and five chapters on Jethro's counsel to Moses.
